actions.name: search
actions.summary: Search Bilibili for videos by keyword. Returns each match with its BV id, title, uploader, duration and play count. Pass a BV id to the play action to watch one.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","required":["keyword"],"properties":{"keyword":{"type":"string","description":"What to search for."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":20,"description":"How many results to return (default 10)."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: trending
actions.summary: What is popular on Bilibili right now. kind 'popular' is the trending feed, 'ranking' is the all-site leaderboard.

actions.name: play
actions.summary: Play a Bilibili video by its BV id on the native full-screen player, with lock-screen controls and picture-in-picture. Get a BV id from the search or trending action first.
